text:
sana: Quick heads-up — we need to align version pins across API, runtime, console, and SDKs before cutoff at 11:00 PT tomorrow. Can folks confirm who owns which repo? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: I can take runtime (gpu-serving). I'll open the runtime bump PR today. Expect ~2hrs of CI flakiness to iron out.

emily: I can do console and the changelog snippet for the public release notes. Planning to push PR by EOD.

sana: awesome — that leaves API and SDKs. @john? @sofia?

john: I'll handle API. Quick Q: are we keeping api v0.14.x or going to v0.15? There are a couple of minor contract changes in v0.15 (model routing header).

sofia: SDKs (python + ts) are on me. I want to avoid breaking changes — I'll do a compat pass and add a runtime-compat matrix in the SDK README.

kevin: deploy-bot FYI: Canary window scheduled 02:00-04:00 PT tomorrow for the runtime pool. If runtime bump lands after the window we fall back to older images.

deploy-bot: Canary window confirmed for 2024-06-05T02:00:00Z to 2024-06-05T04:00:00Z. Automatic rollback enabled.

raj: FYI on runtime: the PR will introduce a small change in kvcache init order — should be backwards compatible but test coverage is light for long-seq caches. I'll add a smoke script:
```
# smoke regen
python tests/smoke/kv_cache_smoke.py --seq-len 2048
```

sana: thanks — add that script to the release checklist so QE can run it during canary.

emily: changelog draft (short):
```
- console: updated model selector UX, added per-route metrics link
- api: support for model-routing header (opt-in)
- runtime: kv-cache init ordering fix; improved batch packing heuristics
- sdk: python/ts compatibility updates; added examples for routing header
```

sofia: small note — SDKs need a minor API shim to accept the routing header without breaking existing callers. I'll create the shim in the python client and mark deprecated in the TS one.

john: API side: I can make the header opt-in via a feature flag so we can flip it after SDK releases. Will open PR with flag default off.

raj: timeline check — my PR earliest ready by 17:30 PT today. API and SDKs EOD? emily & sofia?

emily: EOD for console changelog + PR.

sofia: aiming EOD for SDK PRs, but might slip to +4hrs if shim needs tests. I'll post an update in this thread.

kevin: checklist for cutoff: merge PRs + tag releases, update compatibility matrix in docs, publish SDK packages, and confirm canary start. I'll run the post-merge smoke once all tags are pushed.

sana: action items:
- raj: open runtime PR + smoke script (today 17:30 PT)
- john: open API PR with flag (today EOD)
- emily: console PR + release notes (today EOD)
- sofia: SDK PRs + compat matrix (EOD or +4hrs)
- kevin: coordinate canary + smoke run (tomorrow 02:00 PT)

sofia: noted. I'll add a small compatibility table in the SDK README:
```
runtime >= 0.38.x | api >= 0.15.0 | sdk-python >= 1.6.0 | sdk-ts >= 0.9.0
```

raj: if anyone hits blocking CI flakes on runtime tests ping me directly — I can rebase and force a rerun.

emily: will post the final changelog line in #release-notes after merge.

sana: thanks all. If anything slips beyond cutoff, call it out here so we decide postpone vs partial rollout. :white_check_mark:
